items.title: Aviva Launched a Tokenized Fund on the XRP Ledger
points: Aviva, a major global insurance and investment company, deployed a tokenized fund directly on the XRP Ledger blockchain.

Tokenization converts traditional financial assets into digital tokens on blockchain (digital representation of real-world assets that enables faster settlement and 24/7 trading without intermediaries).
This represents one of the largest institutional deployments of blockchain technology for fund management to date.

The launch demonstrates that enterprise-grade financial institutions now view blockchain infrastructure as production-ready for regulated products, giving XRP Ledger a competitive edge for enterprise adoption.

items.title: SoFi's SOFIE: Bridging Traditional Banking and Crypto Rails
points: SOFIE is the first retail tokenized deposit product from a US nationally chartered bank, with each token representing $1 earning 4.4% APY under FDIC insurance protections.

Members convert SOFIE one-to-one into SoFiUSD, which runs on Ethereum and Solana and settles SoFi's card program via Mastercard's network, connecting yield-bearing deposits to blockchain infrastructure.
The product targets an estimated $64 billion in idle stablecoin capital (about 21% of the stablecoin market) by adding yield and insurance protections that pure stablecoins lack.
This is SoFi's fifth crypto product in under a year, extending the bank's strategy of converting traditional financial products into blockchain-accessible equivalents.

items.title: CoinDCX Loses $16M from Deprecated Wallets
points: CoinDCX lost $16M in USDT (a US dollar-pegged stablecoin) from deprecated wallets tied to its July 2025 hack.
An automated sweeping service failure allowed deposits to accumulate at a vulnerable address for 10 months before being drained.

items.title: Glamsterdam Upgrade Halted Over Critical Gas Mechanism Vulnerabilities
points: ChainSecurity identified flaws in EIP-8037/8038, proposals central to increasing Ethereum's gas limit (the maximum computational work allowed per block) from 60M to 200M, with at least 13 major DeFi protocols affected.

The vulnerability: EIP-8037's gas refill mechanism when storage slots are freed breaks the 1/64 gas guarantee in nested contract calls (a rule ensuring inner contract calls retain enough gas to run), letting attackers trigger outer-contract error handlers that lack gas to execute.

Ethereum Foundation and Ethlabs researchers deployed AI agents overnight to scan for vulnerable contracts, coordinate via GitHub issue comments and shared directories, and produce consolidated findings without human intermediation.

Core developers paused the launch date pending full impact analysis; the same agent-scanning framework is now running against EIP-8198 (Quick Slots, reducing slot time from 12 to 10 seconds) ahead of the Hegotá upgrade.

items.title: On-Chain Options Market Poised to Displace Traditional Derivatives
points: On-chain options currently hold under 1% of perpetual DEX volume despite representing 3x the futures volume in traditional finance, indicating massive growth potential.

10x perpetual positions (futures contracts with no expiry, 10x leverage) carry a 47% liquidation probability over 180 days, making options structurally superior for multi-week trading theses needing downside protection.

Options sellers hedge on perpetual markets, expanding perpetual open interest (total value of outstanding contracts) rather than cannibalizing it; Deribit already shows $2B+ in futures OI sourced from options hedging.

September was the best on-chain options month on record at ~$5B notional volume, with Derive commanding 90%+ of on-chain premium ($18B notional traded, up 1,000%+ year-to-date); Hyperliquid, Derive, and Paradex are positioned as primary beneficiaries of projected growth to 5% of perp volume.
